files.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

# Cancel in-progress runs for the same ref so stale PR builds don't burn minutes.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# Deny all permissions at workflow level; each job declares only what it needs.
permissions: {}

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  fmt:
    name: Format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: rustup component add rustfmt
      - run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
      - name: Check E2E scripts without running native automation
        run: |
          shellcheck -x -e SC2034,SC2154 tests/e2e/run.sh tests/e2e/electron-live.sh tests/e2e/permission-contract.sh tests/e2e/guard-command.sh tests/e2e-linux/run.sh scripts/*.sh .githooks/pre-commit
          PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/agent-desktop-pycache python3 -m py_compile tests/e2e/*.py tests/e2e-linux/runner/*.py tests/e2e-linux/test_*.py tests/e2e-linux/scenarios/*.py
          PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/agent-desktop-pycache python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/e2e -p 'test_*.py'
          AGENT_DESKTOP_E2E_SKIP_LIVE=1 PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/agent-desktop-pycache python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests/e2e-linux -p 'test_*.py'
          python3 scripts/check-linux-findings.py
          shellcheck -x -e SC2034,SC2154 tests/real-apps/numbers-sheets.sh
          PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/agent-desktop-pycache python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/real-apps -p '*_test.py'
          PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/agent-desktop-pycache python3 scripts/perf_ab_probe_test.py
          python3 -I -B scripts/test-linux-live-gate.py
      - name: Validate GitHub Actions workflows
        run: go run github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@v1.7.11


  msrv:
    name: Rust 1.89 MSRV
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: rustup toolchain install 1.89.0 --profile minimal
      - run: cargo +1.89.0 check --locked -p agent-desktop-core -p agent-desktop-linux -p agent-desktop --all-targets

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup show
          rustup component add clippy

      - name: Verify macOS Bash 3.2 compatibility
        run: /bin/bash scripts/check-bash3-compat.sh

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry/index/
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache/
            ~/.cargo/git/db/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', 'crates/**/Cargo.toml', 'src/Cargo.toml') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Cache build artifacts
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: target/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-ci-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', 'crates/**/Cargo.toml', 'src/Cargo.toml') }}-${{ hashFiles('crates/**/*.rs', 'src/**/*.rs', 'tests/**/*.rs') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-ci-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', 'crates/**/Cargo.toml', 'src/Cargo.toml') }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-ci-

      - name: Check dependency isolation
        run: |
          TREE=$(cargo tree --locked -p agent-desktop-core --edges normal,build)
          if printf '%s\n' "$TREE" | grep -E 'agent-desktop-(macos|windows|linux)'; then
            echo "FAIL: core crate depends on platform crates"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: core crate has no platform dependencies"

      - name: Enforce Rust source rules
        run: scripts/check-rust-file-size.sh

      - name: Enforce architecture boundaries
        run: scripts/check-architecture.sh

      - name: Enforce no delivery-plan references in source
        run: scripts/check-no-phase-references.sh

      - name: Enforce the stale_ref constructors take only ref ids
        run: scripts/check-stale-ref-constructor-misuse.sh

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --locked -p agent-desktop-core -p agent-desktop-macos -p agent-desktop -p agent-desktop-ffi --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Core and macOS unit tests
        run: scripts/cargo-test-isolated-home.sh test --locked -p agent-desktop-core -p agent-desktop-macos --lib

      - name: Native cursor trail lifecycle
        run: |
          clang -fobjc-arc -Werror -framework AppKit -framework QuartzCore -framework CoreGraphics tests/native/cursor_overlay_trail_test.m -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/cursor-trail-test"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/cursor-trail-test"

      - name: Native cursor image rendering
        run: |
          clang -fobjc-arc -Werror -framework AppKit -framework QuartzCore -framework CoreGraphics tests/native/cursor_overlay_image_test.m -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/cursor-image-test"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/cursor-image-test"

      - name: Native AppKit inventory names
        run: |
          clang -fobjc-arc -fblocks -Wall -Wextra -Werror -framework AppKit tests/native/appkit_workspace_name_test.m -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/appkit-workspace-name-test"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/appkit-workspace-name-test"

      - name: Locator benchmark adapter contract
        run: scripts/cargo-test-isolated-home.sh test --locked -p agent-desktop-core --example locator_benchmark

      - name: Deterministic permission acceptance contract
        run: bash tests/e2e/permission-contract.sh

      - name: Binary command tests
        run: scripts/cargo-test-isolated-home.sh test --locked -p agent-desktop

      # The FFI crate ships integration harnesses under crates/ffi/tests/ that
      # exercise the C-ABI from outside the crate (raw extern "C" decls, enum
      # fuzzing, out-param zeroing, last-error lifetimes). The workspace --lib
      # run skips them, so wire them in explicitly so regressions fail PR CI.
      - name: FFI integration tests
        run: scripts/cargo-test-isolated-home.sh test --locked -p agent-desktop-ffi --tests

      - name: Build stripped release binary
        run: |
          cargo build --locked --release -p agent-desktop
          cargo build --locked --release -p agent-desktop-macos --bin agent-desktop-macos-helper

      - name: Verify shipped binary version flag
        run: |
          PACKAGE_ID=$(cargo pkgid -p agent-desktop)
          EXPECTED_VERSION=${PACKAGE_ID##*@}
          EXPECTED_OUTPUT="agent-desktop $EXPECTED_VERSION"
          ACTUAL_OUTPUT=$(target/release/agent-desktop --version)
          if [ "$ACTUAL_OUTPUT" != "$EXPECTED_OUTPUT" ]; then
            echo "FAIL: expected '$EXPECTED_OUTPUT', got '$ACTUAL_OUTPUT'"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Check shipped binary size
        run: |
          SIZE=$(stat -f%z target/release/agent-desktop)
          HELPER_SIZE=$(stat -f%z target/release/agent-desktop-macos-helper)
          LIMIT=$((15 * 1024 * 1024))
          echo "Binary size: $(du -sh target/release/agent-desktop | cut -f1)"
          echo "Helper size: $(du -sh target/release/agent-desktop-macos-helper | cut -f1)"
          if [ "$SIZE" -gt "$LIMIT" ] || [ "$HELPER_SIZE" -gt "$LIMIT" ]; then
            echo "FAIL: shipped executable exceeds 15MB limit (binary=${SIZE}, helper=${HELPER_SIZE} bytes)"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: shipped executables are within the 15MB per-file limit"

      - name: FFI cdylib build (release-ffi profile)
        run: cargo build --locked --profile release-ffi -p agent-desktop-ffi

      - name: FFI dylib-adjacent helper discovery smoke
        run: |
          scripts/ci-ffi-helper-discovery-smoke.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: jev-desktop tests
        run: |
          node scripts/jev/run.test.mjs
          node scripts/jev/act.test.mjs
          node scripts/jev/run.integration.test.mjs
          node scripts/jev/evidence.test.mjs

      - name: NPM package contents
        run: |
          node --test tests/npm/*.test.js tests/release/*.test.js
          node scripts/check-npm-package.js

      - name: NPM wrapper smoke
        run: scripts/ci-npm-wrapper-smoke.sh

  test-linux:
    name: Test (Linux)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup show
          rustup component add clippy

      - name: Install AT-SPI bus and virtual display
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends at-spi2-core dbus-x11 xvfb

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry/index/
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache/
            ~/.cargo/git/db/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', 'crates/**/Cargo.toml', 'src/Cargo.toml') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Cache build artifacts
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: target/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-ci-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', 'crates/**/Cargo.toml', 'src/Cargo.toml') }}-${{ hashFiles('crates/**/*.rs', 'src/**/*.rs', 'tests/**/*.rs') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-ci-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', 'crates/**/Cargo.toml', 'src/Cargo.toml') }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-ci-

      - name: Check dependency isolation
        run: |
          PATTERN='agent-desktop-(macos|windows|linux)|\bzbus\b|\bzvariant\b|\basync-io\b|\btokio\b'
          TREE=$(cargo tree --locked -p agent-desktop-core --edges normal,build,dev)
          if printf '%s\n' "$TREE" | grep -E "$PATTERN"; then
            echo "FAIL: core crate pulls platform or async-bus crates"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: core crate has no platform or async-bus dependencies on normal, build, or dev edges"

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --locked -p agent-desktop-core -p agent-desktop-linux -p agent-desktop -p agent-desktop-ffi --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Core, Linux, binary and FFI tests on a real session bus
        run: dbus-run-session -- xvfb-run -a scripts/cargo-test-isolated-home.sh test --locked -p agent-desktop-core -p agent-desktop-linux -p agent-desktop -p agent-desktop-ffi

      - name: Build stripped release binary
        run: cargo build --locked --release -p agent-desktop

      - name: Check shipped binary size
        run: |
          SIZE=$(stat -c%s target/release/agent-desktop)
          LIMIT=$((15 * 1024 * 1024))
          echo "Binary size: $(du -sh target/release/agent-desktop | cut -f1)"
          if [ "$SIZE" -gt "$LIMIT" ]; then
            echo "FAIL: shipped executable exceeds 15MB limit (binary=${SIZE} bytes)"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: shipped executable is within the 15MB per-file limit"

      - name: Build Linux clipboard owner helper
        run: cargo build --locked --release -p agent-desktop-linux --bins

      - name: glibc floor gate self-test
        run: scripts/check-elf-glibc-floor-selftest.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: NPM package contents
        run: |
          node --test tests/npm/*.test.js
          scripts/check-linux-archive-contents.sh npm linux-x64

      - name: Embedded visual viewer tests
        run: node --test src/visual_debug/viewer_filter.test.js

      - name: NPM wrapper smoke
        run: scripts/ci-npm-wrapper-smoke.sh

      - name: Status reports accessibility granted on a live bus
        run: |
          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/status-granted.sh" <<'SCRIPT'
          set -eu
          JSON=$(target/release/agent-desktop status)
          printf '%s\n' "$JSON"
          printf '%s' "$JSON" | python3 -c '
          import json, sys
          doc = json.load(sys.stdin)
          assert doc.get("ok") is True, "status did not succeed"
          state = doc["data"]["permissions"]["accessibility"]["state"]
          assert state == "granted", "accessibility state is " + state
          '
          SCRIPT
          dbus-run-session -- xvfb-run -a bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/status-granted.sh"

      - name: Status and permissions report the missing bus as denied accessibility
        run: |
          XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
          export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/nonexistent XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
          for command in status permissions; do
            JSON=$(target/release/agent-desktop "$command")
            printf '%s\n' "$JSON"
            printf '%s' "$JSON" | python3 -c '
          import json, sys
          doc = json.load(sys.stdin)
          assert doc.get("ok") is True, "the diagnostic failed instead of reporting the bus"
          data = doc["data"]
          access = (data.get("permissions") or data)["accessibility"]
          assert access["state"] == "denied", "accessibility state is " + access["state"]
          assert "session bus" in access["suggestion"], "suggestion does not name the session bus"
          '
          done
          RC=0
          JSON=$(target/release/agent-desktop click @s8f3k2p9:e1) || RC=$?
          test "$RC" -eq 1
          printf '%s\n' "$JSON"
          printf '%s' "$JSON" | python3 -c '
          import json, sys
          doc = json.load(sys.stdin)
          assert doc.get("ok") is False, "click unexpectedly succeeded without a bus"
          assert doc["error"]["code"] == "PERM_DENIED", "unexpected code " + doc["error"]["code"]
          assert "session bus" in doc["error"]["suggestion"], "error does not carry the recovery step"
          '

  test-windows:
    name: Test (Windows)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      lib_tests: ${{ steps.unit_tests.outputs.lib_tests }}
      lib_suites: ${{ steps.unit_tests.outputs.lib_suites }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup show

      # Core resolves its home directory from HOME, then USERPROFILE (crates/core/src/refs/mod.rs), so the lane points both at a throwaway directory.
      - name: Isolate HOME for the whole lane
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $cargoHome  = if ($env:CARGO_HOME)  { $env:CARGO_HOME }  else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cargo' }
          $rustupHome = if ($env:RUSTUP_HOME) { $env:RUSTUP_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.rustup' }
          $testHome = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("agent-desktop-test-home-" + [guid]::NewGuid())
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $testHome | Out-Null
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_ENV -Value "ORIGINAL_USERPROFILE=$env:USERPROFILE"
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_ENV -Value "CARGO_HOME=$cargoHome"
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_ENV -Value "RUSTUP_HOME=$rustupHome"
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_ENV -Value "HOME=$testHome"
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_ENV -Value "USERPROFILE=$testHome"

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ env.CARGO_HOME }}/registry/index/
            ${{ env.CARGO_HOME }}/registry/cache/
            ${{ env.CARGO_HOME }}/git/db/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', 'crates/**/Cargo.toml', 'src/Cargo.toml') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Cache build artifacts
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: target/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-ci-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', 'crates/**/Cargo.toml', 'src/Cargo.toml') }}-${{ hashFiles('crates/**/*.rs', 'src/**/*.rs', 'tests/**/*.rs') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-ci-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', 'crates/**/Cargo.toml', 'src/Cargo.toml') }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-ci-

      - name: Check dependency isolation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $pattern = 'agent-desktop-(macos|windows|linux)|\bwindows-sys\b|\bwindows\b|\bwinapi\b'
          foreach ($target in @('', 'x86_64-pc-windows-msvc')) {
            $arguments = @('tree', '--locked', '-p', 'agent-desktop-core', '--edges', 'normal,build,dev')
            if ($target) { $arguments += @('--target', $target) }
            $tree = cargo @arguments
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
            $violations = @($tree | Select-String -Pattern $pattern)
            if ($violations.Count -gt 0) {
              $violations | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_.Line }
              Write-Host "FAIL: core crate pulls platform or Win32 binding crates (target: '$target')"
              exit 1
            }
          }
          Write-Host 'OK: core crate has no platform dependencies on normal, build, or dev edges'

      - name: Check core source for Win32 leakage
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $sources = Get-ChildItem -Path crates/core/src -Recurse -Filter *.rs
          $forbidden = @($sources | Select-String -Pattern 'extern "system|std::os::windows|\bwinapi\b|\bwindows_sys\b')
          if ($forbidden.Count -gt 0) {
            $forbidden | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "$($_.Path):$($_.LineNumber): $($_.Line.Trim())" }
            Write-Host 'FAIL: core source declares a raw Win32 surface'
            exit 1
          }
          $allowed = (Resolve-Path 'crates/core/src/storage/private_file.rs').Path
          $cfgMatches = @($sources | Select-String -Pattern 'cfg\(windows\)|cfg\(target_os = "windows"\)' -AllMatches)
          $outside = @($cfgMatches | Where-Object { $_.Path -ne $allowed })
          if ($outside.Count -gt 0) {
            $outside | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "$($_.Path):$($_.LineNumber): $($_.Line.Trim())" }
            Write-Host 'FAIL: windows cfg outside the private_file.rs allowlist'
            exit 1
          }
          $shimCount = [int]($cfgMatches | ForEach-Object { $_.Matches.Count } | Measure-Object -Sum).Sum
          if ($shimCount -ne 2) {
            Write-Host "FAIL: expected exactly 2 windows cfg shims in private_file.rs, found $shimCount"
            exit 1
          }
          Write-Host 'OK: core source keeps windows conditionals to the 2 allowlisted shims'

      - name: Check Win32_UI_Shell exclusion
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\check-win32-ui-shell-exclusion.ps1

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --locked -p agent-desktop-core -p agent-desktop-windows -p agent-desktop -p agent-desktop-ffi --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Core and Windows unit tests
        id: unit_tests
        env:
          AGENT_DESKTOP_LIVE_WPF: "1"
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $output = cmd /c "cargo test --locked -p agent-desktop-core -p agent-desktop-windows --lib 2>&1"
          $output | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          $passed = 0
          $suites = 0
          foreach ($line in @($output)) {
            if ("$line" -match '^test result: ok\.\s+(\d+) passed;.*?(\d+) filtered out' -and [int]$Matches[2] -eq 0) {
              $passed += [int]$Matches[1]
              $suites += 1
            }
          }
          Write-Host "Total lib tests passed: $passed across $suites whole-suite runs"
          if ($suites -eq 0 -or $passed -eq 0) {
            Write-Error "Parsed $passed passing tests across $suites suites; the lib-test output format changed and this counter measured nothing."
            exit 1
          }
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Value "lib_tests=$passed"
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Value "lib_suites=$suites"

      - name: Windows example tests
        run: cargo test --locked -p agent-desktop-windows --examples

      - name: Binary command tests
        run: cargo test --locked -p agent-desktop

      - name: FFI integration tests
        run: cargo test --locked -p agent-desktop-ffi --tests

      - name: Build stripped release binary
        run: cargo build --locked --release -p agent-desktop

      - name: Windows E2E contract gate (scan and self-test halves)
        shell: powershell
        run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\check-e2e-windows-contract.ps1 -SelfTest

      - name: Seeded-failure run asserts a non-zero exit code
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\tests\e2e-windows\Run-E2E.ps1 -SelfTestSeedFailure
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
            Write-Host 'FAIL: Run-E2E.ps1 -SelfTestSeedFailure exited 0; a failing leg must reach a non-zero exit code'
            exit 1
          }
          Write-Host "OK: Run-E2E.ps1 -SelfTestSeedFailure exited $LASTEXITCODE"
          exit 0

      - name: Capture redaction gate
        shell: powershell
        run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\check-capture-redaction.ps1

      - name: run-windows-e2e-ci.ps1 refusal-guard self-test
        shell: powershell
        run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\fixtures\run-windows-e2e-ci-refusal-selftest.ps1

      - name: E2E fixture compile smoke
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $smokeOut = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'agent-desktop-fixture-smoke'
          powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\tests\fixture-app-windows\build.ps1 -OutputDir $smokeOut
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Host "FAIL: tests\fixture-app-windows\build.ps1 exited $LASTEXITCODE"
            exit 1
          }
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $smokeOut 'AgentDeskFixture.exe'))) {
            Write-Host 'FAIL: build.ps1 reported success but AgentDeskFixture.exe is missing'
            exit 1
          }
          Write-Host 'OK: the E2E fixture compiles under the pinned in-box csc.exe'

      - name: Check shipped binary size
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $binary = Get-Item target/release/agent-desktop.exe
          $limit = 15MB
          Write-Host "Binary size: $($binary.Length) bytes"
          if ($binary.Length -gt $limit) {
            Write-Host "FAIL: shipped executable exceeds 15MB limit (binary=$($binary.Length) bytes)"
            exit 1
          }
          Write-Host 'OK: shipped executable is within the 15MB per-file limit'

      - name: Guard profile isolation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          if (-not $env:HOME -or -not $env:HOME.StartsWith($env:RUNNER_TEMP, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
            Write-Host "FAIL: HOME is not under RUNNER_TEMP: $env:HOME"
            exit 1
          }
          if (-not $env:USERPROFILE -or -not $env:USERPROFILE.StartsWith($env:RUNNER_TEMP, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
            Write-Host "FAIL: USERPROFILE is not under RUNNER_TEMP: $env:USERPROFILE"
            exit 1
          }
          $leak = Join-Path $env:ORIGINAL_USERPROFILE '.agent-desktop'
          if (Test-Path $leak) {
            Write-Host "FAIL: a test escaped the isolated HOME and wrote $leak"
            exit 1
          }
          Write-Host 'OK: private artifacts stayed under RUNNER_TEMP'

  test-windows-arm:
    name: Test (Windows ARM64)
    runs-on: windows-11-arm
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      lib_tests: ${{ steps.unit_tests.outputs.lib_tests }}
      lib_suites: ${{ steps.unit_tests.outputs.lib_suites }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup show

      - name: Isolate HOME for the whole lane
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $cargoHome  = if ($env:CARGO_HOME)  { $env:CARGO_HOME }  else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cargo' }
          $rustupHome = if ($env:RUSTUP_HOME) { $env:RUSTUP_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.rustup' }
          $testHome = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("agent-desktop-test-home-" + [guid]::NewGuid())
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $testHome | Out-Null
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_ENV -Value "ORIGINAL_USERPROFILE=$env:USERPROFILE"
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_ENV -Value "CARGO_HOME=$cargoHome"
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_ENV -Value "RUSTUP_HOME=$rustupHome"
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_ENV -Value "HOME=$testHome"
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_ENV -Value "USERPROFILE=$testHome"

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ env.CARGO_HOME }}/registry/index/
            ${{ env.CARGO_HOME }}/registry/cache/
            ${{ env.CARGO_HOME }}/git/db/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', 'crates/**/Cargo.toml', 'src/Cargo.toml') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-cargo-

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --locked -p agent-desktop-core -p agent-desktop-windows -p agent-desktop -p agent-desktop-ffi --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Core and Windows unit tests
        id: unit_tests
        env:
          AGENT_DESKTOP_LIVE_WPF: "1"
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $output = cmd /c "cargo test --locked -p agent-desktop-core -p agent-desktop-windows --lib 2>&1"
          $output | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          $passed = 0
          $suites = 0
          foreach ($line in @($output)) {
            if ("$line" -match '^test result: ok\.\s+(\d+) passed;.*?(\d+) filtered out' -and [int]$Matches[2] -eq 0) {
              $passed += [int]$Matches[1]
              $suites += 1
            }
          }
          Write-Host "Total lib tests passed: $passed across $suites whole-suite runs"
          if ($suites -eq 0 -or $passed -eq 0) {
            Write-Error "Parsed $passed passing tests across $suites suites; the lib-test output format changed and this counter measured nothing."
            exit 1
          }
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Value "lib_tests=$passed"
          Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Value "lib_suites=$suites"

      - name: Build release binary
        run: cargo build --locked --release -p agent-desktop

      - name: Install the packed npm package and run it through the shim
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $env:AGENT_DESKTOP_BINARY_PATH = (Resolve-Path 'target/release/agent-desktop.exe').Path
          Push-Location npm
          npm pack
          $tarball = Get-ChildItem -Filter 'agent-desktop-*.tgz' | Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $tarball) { Write-Host 'FAIL: npm pack produced no tarball'; exit 1 }
          Pop-Location
          $prefix = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'npm-arm64-prefix'
          npm install -g $tarball.FullName --prefix $prefix
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host "FAIL: npm install exited $LASTEXITCODE"; exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          & (Join-Path $prefix 'agent-desktop.cmd') version
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host "FAIL: agent-desktop version through the npm shim exited $LASTEXITCODE"; exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          Write-Host 'OK: the win32-arm64 table entry resolves and runs through the npm shim'

      - name: Guard profile isolation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          if (-not $env:HOME -or -not $env:HOME.StartsWith($env:RUNNER_TEMP, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
            Write-Host "FAIL: HOME is not under RUNNER_TEMP: $env:HOME"
            exit 1
          }
          if (-not $env:USERPROFILE -or -not $env:USERPROFILE.StartsWith($env:RUNNER_TEMP, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
            Write-Host "FAIL: USERPROFILE is not under RUNNER_TEMP: $env:USERPROFILE"
            exit 1
          }
          $leak = Join-Path $env:ORIGINAL_USERPROFILE '.agent-desktop'
          if (Test-Path $leak) {
            Write-Host "FAIL: a test escaped the isolated HOME and wrote $leak"
            exit 1
          }
          Write-Host 'OK: private artifacts stayed under RUNNER_TEMP'

  windows-lib-test-parity:
    name: Windows lib-test parity (x64 vs ARM64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test-windows, test-windows-arm]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Compare exported lib test counts
        run: |
          X64="${{ needs.test-windows.outputs.lib_tests }}"
          ARM="${{ needs.test-windows-arm.outputs.lib_tests }}"
          X64_SUITES="${{ needs.test-windows.outputs.lib_suites }}"
          ARM_SUITES="${{ needs.test-windows-arm.outputs.lib_suites }}"
          echo "x64 lane lib tests: ${X64}; ARM64 lane lib tests: ${ARM}"
          if [ -z "$X64" ] || [ -z "$ARM" ]; then
            echo "FAIL: a lane did not export its lib test count (x64='${X64}', arm64='${ARM}')"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$X64" = "0" ] || [ "$ARM" = "0" ]; then
            echo "FAIL: a lane exported zero lib tests (x64='${X64}', arm64='${ARM}') - the count extraction stopped matching cargo's summary line"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$X64_SUITES" != "$ARM_SUITES" ]; then
            echo "FAIL: the lanes summed different numbers of whole-suite runs (x64='${X64_SUITES}', arm64='${ARM_SUITES}') - one lane's summary line was not parsed, so the totals are not comparable"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$X64" != "$ARM" ]; then
            echo "FAIL: ARM64 executed ${ARM} lib tests against the x64 lane's ${X64}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: both Windows lanes executed ${X64} lib tests across ${X64_SUITES} whole-suite runs"

  # FFI gates, one matrix leg per release target:
  #   - every leg asserts that [profile.release-ffi] keeps panic="unwind" (a
  #     flip to "abort" defeats every trap_panic boundary in the dylib) and
  #     loads the feature-gated cdylib panic entrypoint to prove a panic at an
  #     exported boundary returns ErrInternal instead of aborting the host
  #   - aarch64-apple-darwin also verifies the committed C header against what
  #     the pinned cbindgen 0.29.4 generates, and runs the Python smoke harness
  #     against a stub-adapter cdylib
  #   - x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu also runs the stub-adapter passthrough tests:
  #     each covered entrypoint must return PLATFORM_NOT_SUPPORTED, or the
  #     documented ErrPermDenied for ad_check_permissions
  ffi-panic-guard:
    name: FFI Panic Guard (${{ matrix.target }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.target == 'aarch64-apple-darwin' && 30 || 20 }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            runner: macos-latest
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            runner: macos-latest
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-22.04
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-22.04-arm
          - target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            runner: windows-latest
          - target: aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
            runner: windows-11-arm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup show
          rustup target add ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry/index/
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache/
            ~/.cargo/git/db/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', 'crates/**/Cargo.toml', 'src/Cargo.toml') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Install pinned cbindgen 0.29.4
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-apple-darwin'
        run: cargo install cbindgen --version 0.29.4 --locked

      - name: Verify header matches source (cbindgen --verify)
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-apple-darwin'
        run: >
          cbindgen crates/ffi
          --config crates/ffi/cbindgen.toml
          --output crates/ffi/include/agent_desktop.h
          --verify

      - name: Build FFI dylib (stub adapter)
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-apple-darwin'
        run: >
          cargo build --locked --profile release-ffi
          -p agent-desktop-ffi --features stub-adapter

      - name: Locate dylib
        id: dylib
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-apple-darwin'
        run: |
          DYLIB=$(find target/release-ffi -name 'libagent_desktop_ffi.*' \
                    \( -name '*.dylib' -o -name '*.so' -o -name '*.dll' \) | head -1)
          if [ -z "$DYLIB" ]; then
            echo "FAIL: dylib not found under target/release-ffi"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "path=$DYLIB" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-apple-darwin'
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Run FFI smoke harness
        if: matrix.target == 'aarch64-apple-darwin'
        env:
          AD_EXPECT_STUB: "1"
        run: >
          python3 tests/ffi-python/smoke.py
          "${{ steps.dylib.outputs.path }}"
          crates/ffi/include/agent_desktop.h

      - name: Run stub-adapter passthrough tests
        if: matrix.target == 'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu'
        run: >
          scripts/cargo-test-isolated-home.sh test --locked -p agent-desktop-ffi
          --features stub-adapter --test c_abi_passthrough

      - name: Assert release-ffi profile keeps panic=unwind
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if ! grep -A5 '\[profile\.release-ffi\]' Cargo.toml | grep -q 'panic.*=.*"unwind"'; then
            echo "FAIL: [profile.release-ffi] must set panic=\"unwind\" — a flip to"
            echo "      panic=\"abort\" defeats every trap_panic boundary in the dylib."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: release-ffi profile retains panic=\"unwind\""

      - name: Prove the shipped cdylib catches an exported-boundary panic
        shell: bash
        run: bash crates/ffi/tests/run_cdylib_panic_probe.sh ${{ matrix.target }}
